ACTION 10 OF 32 · PHASE 03

Generate a first visual website

Get a real concept you can see, click and share.

WHEN TO DO THISAfter writing the mobile site brief.ESTIMATED WORK TIME1–2 hours
↗
Your one job

Get a real concept you can see, click and share.

01

Do this now

  1. 01

    Create a preview using Lovable, a simple static HTML site or another tool you already have access to.

  2. 02

    Supply actual service descriptions, brand tone, real business photos or explicitly labeled placeholders.

  3. 03

    Ask for working mobile navigation and one simple enquiry or demo action.

  4. 04

    Keep the preview separate from a production booking/payment system until security and processes are ready.

02

Copy this into ChatGPT

Replace anything in [square brackets] with your real business details. The prompt is a shortcut, not a substitute for the steps above.

READY-TO-USE PROMPT
Build a clean, mobile-first website prototype for [BUSINESS] based on the attached brief. Focus on one offer and primary CTA [CTA]. Design premium but simple: strong typography, clear hierarchy, high contrast, accessible tap targets, relevant authentic Caribbean context when appropriate. Use marked placeholders for missing photos or proof. Include About, How It Works, Offer, FAQs, and Contact/Request flow. No fake clients, fabricated outcomes, dummy buttons disguised as working bookings, or unnecessary AI widgets. This is a validation prototype; document which parts are not production-ready.
03

Finish with this

A shareable website preview with one usable customer journey.

Before moving on, check your work against the following:

  • Preview URL opens on a phone
  • All visible controls work or are clearly marked as demo
  • Potential customers can reach the CTA
DON’T MAKE THIS MISTAKE

Confusing a visual prototype with secure production software.

READY TO MOVE ON?

A customer can understand the offer and find the next action on mobile without explanation.
